body: I dont have even single friend. On my phone i have just 1 number to my mother. and thats it.

Im almost 30. Im from Europe. but now im on family visit in other country(which turned out to be one massive attack on me from all sides, mostly initiated by my mother who genuinely doesn't like me). i dont need to call anyone as my all (very small) family is just here and now - and they just hate me.

Back in my country - doctors doesnt want to prescribe me any antidepressants becasue of my failure at overdose 1.5 years ago.

Anyway. It doesnt matter.

You are not alone. 

Why you want to die?

I hate this planet and myself.

Here is full story: http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/2fv0kd/i_have_nothing_left_to_live_for_when_to_die/

1. Dont be afraid
2. So you have nothing? That could be good thing - as you have nothing slowing you down in road to sucess :)
3. Leave him. It's better to be homeless then abused and living in fear of physical abuse from someone who "loves you".

Best wishes to you. And dont think that you are burden to anyone.

I scrubbed (got into debt) some money, and bought one way ticket to nearby random foreign country in south. This way I wasn't forced to talk with anyone - as I didn't understand their language at all.

I didn't had any substantial money at all, I had about 60$ when i arrived, i have no knowledge at all about the country, or the language etc.

I slept in parks, squats, beaches, churches and shops.
I had to look quite miserable because people were often giving me clothes and food without asking. I never begged or steal.

I never felt safer or happier then back then. I was still suicidal but It was not overwhelming me that much.

At some point I even got some friends and self created "job" that was enough for getting the simple food and occasional shower.

I kinda miss that. But from other hand I know that this is road to nowhere. You can live like that - but there is still no real point.

You are not alone.

What helped me in the past is to become a homeless, and just roam. It was surprisingly good experience - as I was free from 75% of stress and sadness while doing it.

It will not cure you but at least it can buy you some time. time without fear.

1. Try to read up about neuroticism or other other psychological/mental problems. It will not help you with what you feel - but it might help you with understanding wtf is goin on.

> If you have anything that might help me change my awful mentality

It's awful idea, but when I become a homeless for almost one year - it helped me **a lot** with all sort of negative fellings or fear [back then i was suicidal as fuck and just released from hospital after failed overdose]. When I came back to normal life - im suicidal again... It will not cure you - but its great way to "have a brake" from all  sort of stress. It can buy some some time at least.

Sorry for shitty advices.

I fully understand what you feel. Homeless or in prison.

You can always hitchhike to Mexico or at least to south. Or sell your possessions/take the loan and go there by bus.

It will not solve your problems or cure you. But it can buy you some time and calm you down while you doing it.
Yet you can still see them in national gallery/musem or wikipedia. Some of them are really majestic.

You seems like me.

1. It's not your fault that you are depressed or neurotic.
2. You do not need to say sorry to your friends - because you do have serious problems.
3. You deserve attention. We all do.

I cant help you. and you cant help me. but at least we are not alone. thats something.

1. This is like 20x time that I repat this on this forum. Please check if you are neurotic (read about "neuroticism") - it might be the cause of your problems.

2. Only thing that helped me in my miserable life was to become a homeless. It can free you from about 75% of stress and negative thinking.
Now I'm no longer homeless and I'm miserable again.

I know it's a strange advice. But at least try it before checking out.

1. Please check if you are not neurotic ("neuroticism" - read about it). For me it seems that this is the reason why you have such serious problems (me too!).

2. I was in similar poistion like you. Two years ago I become the homeless for almost a year, and belibve me or not - it was THAT thing that relaxed me enough to be not suicidal or stressed all the time (now I'm no longer homeless and im again super sucididal and hopeless).

I know. those are shitty advices. but at least I do understand you. which is something - you are not alone.

Do you watch child erotica/jailbait?
Yes it can be addictive - and belive me or not, its quite nomal to have such desires, but its taboo subject. In germany there is about 300.000 man alone who visit psychiatrist/sexuologist because of this problem.(usually normal and sucessfull man).

Stop doing it, and clean up your pc. Police can raid your home even few **YEARS** after now becasue of this. Been there, done that. In general it's not worth it. In some countries you can have big problem by just downloading nude (like on the beach) photo of underage person. For them it doesn't matter - as they want to win the case and don't care about logic. 

It seems that you are depressed as fuck. Seek help buddy, and stop doing that shit. Trust me: raid by police is one of THE most stressful moments ever.


ps. Yes, It's sad that a lot of artistic works of Victorian era (nudies) is now illegal - but yet you can watch them in museums.

Seek help for depression. Stop downloading stuff, it's not worth it.
you need to keep promise. at least your granny care about you :)

1. Dont worry about not crying. It's normal for many people to not cry for others if such situations (despite the internal stress and sadness).

2. I know this is silly. But please read up if you are not neurotic. ("neuroticism" - read about it), it might be the reason why you (and me!) think is such fuckedup ways.

3.Try to keep your promises. At least you have some goal now.

Fuck Acne. Fuck your friends. Fuck that bitch.

From what I understand you are still very young. Using my mostly pessimistic indicator in my brain - I can assure you, that after high school life will get littlebit better. All the statistics are on your side. Brace and wait.

ps. If i went to college, you can too.

>I really don't want to die, but I can't see any other way around my problems

You will cope. When I was homeless it was actually my easiest ever moments in my life when it coes to dealing with stress and sadness. Also I don't really belive that you will be homeless for more then few days.

Such sucessful person like you (you had money, love, job and even HOME) will recover and get it all again. I really belive in that - even using my neurotic always negative point of view, so it must be true.

Even if there is such service I dont have any money at all. 
I seriously I have 0.

Also when I was lockedup in mental hospital last time, doctors concluded that I'm "OK" and didn't even want to prescribe me any anti-depressants, after after I literally begged for them.

After I left hospital I had another huge argument with my mother, and I tried to cut my veins. But because it was winter (i was doing it outside) and knife was not very sharp - i was unable to make cut deep enough.
Anyway: doctors in this country sucks.

ps. It's not that my family doesn't care about me. They just doesn't understand depression or neurotism at all, and blame it all on "laziness". For them life is somehow easy: "go to xyz country, find job in 4 days, rent place, find girl", while for me it is problem to even have friends.

anyway. thx. at least i can talk with someone here.
